title: Global Natural and Planted Forests at 30 m, v1
description: Global map of natural and planted forests at about 30 m for about 2020, by Xiao Yuelong (2024). Republished by Epoch as 1,010 single-band class-map COG tiles of about 5 degrees (0 non-forest, 1 natural forest, 2 planted forest): converted from the source's RGB colour encoding with a lossless rule and flipped north-up, with pixel values unchanged. Tiles overlap their neighbours by 1 pixel. A materialised icechunk cube holds the same pixels as one global array. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for tested access recipes.
